package.name: bonbon_base_controller
package.description: Differential-drive kinematics and dead-reckoning odometry for the Rhino 24V wheel motors (Cytron MDDS30, via bonbon_hal's motor_node). Converts the safety_gate_node-approved /cmd_vel into per-wheel speed commands, and integrates wheel distance readings into nav_msgs/Odometry for Nav2. Has no motion authority of its own -- it only translates an already-approved velocity command; it never originates one. This is the fix for docs/HARDWARE_SOFTWARE_GAP_REPORT.md item 1 (CRITICAL), alongside bonbon_hal's CytronMDDS30Driver (the raw hardware I/O layer this package sits above).
